verdict.rationale: DGX B200 is customer-owned hardware run in the buyer's own data center. It ships with local administration: a BMC with Redfish/IPMI/KVM/Web UI, a command-line health tool, node-wide GPU management, and Docker plus the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. Hands-on community reports show operators virtualizing B200 systems on their own infrastructure, though the required Fabric Manager is proprietary. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party on-premises installation and site-requirements guide in the evidence, and a fully open software stack (Fabric Manager is closed source).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Provides active health monitoring and system alerts for NVIDIA DGX nodes in a data center.
This software enables node-wide administration of GPUs and can be used for cluster and data-center level management.
Supports Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM, and Web user interface
You can also contact NVIDIA Enterprise Support for help in moving the DGX B200 system.
